articles.title: Navi Mumbai airport to offer free high-speed Wi-Fi, digital-first passenger communication
articles.summary: Adani Group's Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIAL) will deploy a digital-first passenger communication system, featuring free high-speed Wi-Fi upon its commercial opening. This initiative aims to modernize airport operations and significantly enhance passenger experience. Such advanced infrastructure projects underscore India's commitment to digital integration and developing world-class national facilities, crucial for connectivity and economic growth.

articles.title: ISRO to launch next-gen communication satellite on Dec 24 as part of US firm deal
articles.summary: ISRO's LVM3 M6 mission will launch the BlueBird Block-2 satellite on December 24, under a commercial deal with US-based AST SpaceMobile. This highlights India's significant advancements in space technology and ISRO's expanding capabilities in global commercial satellite deployment. The mission reinforces India's growing international collaborations and strategic presence in the competitive space sector.
